name: APT Medical Inc.
summary: APT Medical Inc. is a global enterprise dedicated to the research, development, production, and commercialization of invasive interventional medical devices primarily targeting cardiovascular and cerebrovascular diseases. Its extensive product portfolio encompasses a range of electrophysiological tools, including catheter delivery systems, alongside radiofrequency ablation and mapping catheters. Additionally, APT Medical provides various vascular intervention solutions, spanning diagnostic and therapeutic devices, as well as essential intervention accessories. Beyond its proprietary offerings, the company extends its expertise through OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) and ODM (Original Design Manufacturer) services for catheter and metal-based products, including associated accessories. Established in 2002, APT Medical maintains its corporate headquarters in Shenzhen, China.
